annotations.title: Mark a game owned or not owned

description: Mark a game as owned ("own") or no longer owned ("disown") for the authenticated user. The website treats this as toggle-like — calling "own" twice will error on the second call because the first ownership record is still open. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

removedAt.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. Only meaningful when action is 'disown'. Must be today or earlier.

name: kineticist_toggle_ownership
